content.short: A Cardano-based launchpad providing services for startups without requiring KYC or business information.
content.description: Our mission at Genesis Launchpad is to provide services for smaller startups that would otherwise not have access to raise funds and awareness. At Genesis Launchpad we do not require KYC or business information, allowing consumers and developers from less developed countries to build on and participate in the Cardano ecosystem.
